negative_control: zh-CN/wire.errors.sdk_spec: wire.errors.sdk_spec.agent_identity_conflict: arguments (('unexpected', 'simple'),) != en's (): en has 0 argument(s), translation has 1

rows.source: agent_name and agent_id are mutually exclusive
rows.target: agent_name和agent_id不能同时指定

rows.source: ApprovalPolicy.callback() requires a callable gate
rows.target: ApprovalPolicy.callback()需要可调用的审批函数

rows.source: ApprovalPolicy.declared() must name at least one tool; use ApprovalPolicy.refuse() for an undeclared bound session
rows.target: ApprovalPolicy.declared()必须指定至少一个工具；对于未声明工具的绑定会话，使用ApprovalPolicy.refuse()

rows.source: ApprovalPolicy.handler is only meaningful for mode ''callback'', not {mode}
rows.target: ApprovalPolicy.handler仅对''callback''模式有意义，不适用于{mode}

rows.source: ApprovalPolicy.tools is only meaningful for mode ''declared'', not {mode}
rows.target: ApprovalPolicy.tools仅对''declared''模式有意义，不适用于{mode}

rows.source: mode=''attach'' opens a viewer for spec.resume; it does not attach teams, profiles, tools, names, goals or approval policies — that is the owner''s side. Set only resume on this spec (or use mode=''own''). Offending fields: {fields}.
rows.target: mode=''attach''会打开spec.resume所指会话的查看器；不会附加团队、配置档案、工具、名称、目标或审批策略——这些由会话控制方负责。此spec中只能设置resume（或使用mode=''own''）。不支持的字段：{fields}。

rows.source: output enforcement cannot be set on an attached session; the owning runtime decides
rows.target: 不能为附接的会话设置输出约束；这由控制该会话的运行时决定

rows.source: mode=''attach'' needs spec.resume: a viewer attaches to an id
rows.target: mode=''attach''需要spec.resume：查看器通过会话ID附接到会话

rows.source: mode must be ''own'' or ''attach'', not {mode}
rows.target: mode必须为''own''或''attach''，不能为{mode}

rows.source: output_format must be one of {formats}
rows.target: output_format必须为以下值之一：{formats}

rows.source: output_retries must be between 0 and 5
rows.target: output_retries必须在0到5之间

rows.source: output_retries requires output_format
rows.target: 设置output_retries需要同时设置output_format

rows.source: output_schema requires output_format
rows.target: 设置output_schema需要同时设置output_format

rows.source: resume must be a session id or "@latest", not an empty string
rows.target: resume必须为会话ID或"@latest"，不能是空字符串

rows.source: birth_effort for a new spawned session rides the birth sample and needs the hosting/model pair alongside it; state all three, or open the session in-process (open_session) to set a birth level without a model pair.
rows.target: 新建子会话的birth_effort随创建时的参数快照传递，需要同时提供hosting/model参数对；同时指定这三个参数，或在当前进程中打开会话（open_session），以便不指定模型参数对也能设置初始推理强度。

rows.source: spawn_session() cannot deliver post-open state to a new runtime child; unsupported fields on this spec: {fields}. Open the session in-process (open_session), attach what you need, dispose, then spawn_session() the same id — resume restores the attachment; or spawn without these fields.
rows.target: spawn_session()无法将会话打开后的状态传递给新建的运行时子进程；此spec中不支持的字段：{fields}。在当前进程中打开会话（open_session），附加所需内容，调用dispose释放会话，然后用spawn_session()启动同一会话ID——resume会恢复附加内容；或者不设置这些字段再启动子会话。

rows.source: spawn_session() routes hosting/model to a NEW runtime as one birth sample; state both, or neither (the child then resolves its model from the root''s config).
rows.target: spawn_session()会将hosting/model作为同一份创建时参数快照传递给新的运行时；同时指定这两个参数，或都不指定（子进程将从根配置中解析所用模型）。

rows.source: spawn_session() cannot carry output enforcement ({fields}); open the session with open_session(..., mode=''own'') and engage it afterwards
rows.target: spawn_session()无法传递输出约束（{fields}）；先用open_session(..., mode=''own'')打开会话，再让它开始工作

rows.source: tools must name at least one tool; leave it None to stay unrestricted
rows.target: tools必须指定至少一个工具；若不限制工具，将其保留为None

rows.source: world_root must be a non-empty path when set
rows.target: 设置world_root时，必须指定非空路径

rows.source: yolo=True makes an ApprovalPolicy.{approval_mode}() gate unreachable; use ApprovalPolicy.auto() (or drop yolo) instead
rows.target: yolo=True会使ApprovalPolicy.{approval_mode}()审批函数无法被调用；改用ApprovalPolicy.auto()（或移除yolo设置）
